question: Which of the following rivers is a peninsular river and flows eastward?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mahanadi River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahanadi River** is one of the prominent **peninsular rivers** of India that flows **eastward**.
 
• It originates in the **Dhamtari district of Chhattisgarh**.
 
• The river flows through the states of **Chhattisgarh and Odisha** before emptying into the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• The Mahanadi is the **third largest river** in peninsular India after the **Godavari and Krishna rivers**.
 
• It has several tributaries, including the **Seonath, Hasdeo, Mand, and Ib rivers**.
 
• One of its major features is the **Hirakud Dam**, which is the **longest earthen dam in the world**, located near Sambalpur in Odisha.
 
• The river is a key source of **irrigation** and supports agriculture in the regions it flows through.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sabarmati River**__

 __
 
• The **Sabarmati River** flows through the Indian states of **Rajasthan and Gujarat**.
 
• It originates from the **Aravalli hills** in Rajasthan and flows into the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• The river is important for **water supply** and irrigation in Gujarat.
 
 
 
• **Narmada River**__
 __
 
• The **Narmada River** is one of the most important west-flowing rivers in India.
 
• It originates from **Amarkantak in Madhya Pradesh** and flows into the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• The river is known for its **cultural significance** and is often referred to as the **"Life Line of Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat"**.
 
 
 
• **Tapti River**__
 
 
• The **Tapti River** is another west-flowing river in India.
 
• It originates from the **Satpura ranges in Madhya Pradesh** and flows into the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• The Tapti River is known for flowing parallel to the **Narmada River**.
